day.headline: A Rooster day — Ox and Snake are in step.

reasons: Dragon pairs with Rooster — a harmonious day
signs.message: Whole car to yourself. Spread out, take the good seat.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That intro actually landed. Follow up before the day cools.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Your drink hit the counter in ten seconds. Take the omen.

reasons: Snake and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: They got your title wrong. Correct it out loud, lightly.

reasons: Rooster's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: It's whipping out there. Wear what doesn't need the wind's cooperation.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: tapping a doorframe on the way out
signs.message: You tap the doorframe every time you leave. Keep doing it.

reasons: Ox and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a desk you never sit at
signs.message: That desk is decoration. Sit at it for one actual hour.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: someone easy to be quiet with
signs.message: Text the person you can sit around saying nothing with.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: A fee to touch your own money. Cash can wait.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer

reasons: Rat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Your ID photo is a crime. The renewal keeps until later.

reasons: Rabbit opposes Rooster — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a sky worth looking up at
signs.message: Sunset's showing off. Watch from the window, stay in tonight.
